title: ci: fail fast on the test, test-ui and dogfood matrices in the merge queue only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSRBDKqdoCoEAF1SZ4CCZZs)_

Fixes #31517

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：合并队列（`merge_group`）里，Test Core、Test UI、Dogfood 三个测试矩阵改成「一个分片红了，其余分片立即停止」。PR、push、定时运行不变，仍然每个分片都跑完。
- **为什么改**：以前队列里一个分片已经红了，还要等最慢的分片（Test Core 最慢片中位约 19 分钟）跑完聚合检查才报红，排在后面的条目也跟着干等。按裁决 6730013883（A）执行。
- **风险与回滚**：只用矩阵自带的 fail-fast，没有取消整次运行，真红仍然是红（聚合检查读到 `failure`）。代价是队列运行只显示第一个红分片，完整红单仍在作者的 PR 运行里。回滚：把三处表达式改回 `false`。
- **先看**：`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 里 `test` 任务的 `strategy` 段（表达式和说明）；`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` 新增的 #31517 自测电池；`ci.yml` 里 `dogfood` 与 `test-ui` 的 `strategy` 段。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test`，预期最后一行是 `✓ check-shard-attestation --self-test: 350 assertions …`，并且 `grep -n 'fail-fast:' .github/workflows/ci.yml` 恰好三行，都是 `${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}`。
- **需要你做的**：审阅并亲手合并（`.github/workflows/**` 属 Tier H）。

## What changes

- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**: `strategy.fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}` on `test` (Test Core), `test-ui` (Test UI) and `dogfood` (Dogfood Regression Gate), as ruled (ruling record 6730013883, letter A). The expression is false on `pull_request`, `push`, `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`, so those runs keep every shard running to its end. It is the matrix's own fail-fast; there is no run-level cancel and no `concurrency` change.
- **The A1 wording** (#23177 ruling B, item A1, comment 6139629628): the `test` strategy comment says why the queue is the exception (its job is a fast mergeable-or-not answer, and the PR run of the same diff already showed every red); the Test Core step's A1 note now says A1 holds inside a shard on every event and the queue is the exception across shards; the `dogfood`, `test-ui`, Dogfood Regression Gate and Test UI aggregate comments say how each reads the fail-fast shape.
- **`scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`**: a new self-test battery, `#31517 merge-queue fail-fast: one shard red, the rest cancelled by the strategy` (8 cases, roster floor 25 → 26), and a header paragraph. No verdict logic changes. The cases: a red shard beside attested and fail-fast-cancelled siblings is red by the declared negative and by the count; a red shard with zero attestations is red (`failure` is never the zero-attestation #3668 pass); a `failure` matrix asks no cancel cause; the measured fail-fast cancel annotation classifies as `other`, never a supersession; if a matrix ever read `cancelled` after a sibling attested, that cause still reds it; a planned (#26084) roster cut short is red; the Dogfood Regression Gate reads a red dogfood shard with a cancelled sibling as red.
- **`scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`**: its self-test fixture job spelled `fail-fast: false`; it now spells the new expression, so the reader is exercised over the line ci.yml carries. The other three scripts the card named (`check-shard-attestation.mjs`, `check-aggregator-roster.mjs`, `partition-test-shards.mjs`) pin no `fail-fast` anchor: `git grep -n fail-fast -- scripts` at f2abd476 hits `ci-shard-matrix.mjs:220` only, plus unrelated step-level fail-fast prose in `scripts/ci/lane-verdict.mjs` and `scripts/pm/ci-failure.mjs`.

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs` (static guard over ci.yml): exit 0, `✓ check-shard-attestation: 2 aggregate gate(s) count 3 declared leg(s) across 3 attesting job(s).`
- `node scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `27 cases pass across 5 batteries (live: test=8, dogfood=3, test-ui=16)`
- `node scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs --self-test`: exit 0 (63 assertions); live: exit 0
- `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`: exit 0
- `node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`: exit 0

</details>

<details><summary>The new cases can fail: two mutations, red, then restored (committed head, in-place edit, `git checkout HEAD --` restore, blob hash checked)</summary>

- `classifyCancelAnnotations` also reading `The strategy configuration was canceled` as a supersession: self-test exit 1, failing exactly `#31517: a shard cancelled by its matrix's fail-fast is never read as a supersession` and `#31517: were the matrix ever to read cancelled after a sibling attested, the fail-fast cause still reds it…`.
- `judge()` routing a `failure` leg into the `cancelled` branch: self-test exit 1, failing exactly `#31517: the first shard red before any sibling attested, all cancelled ⇒ red…`.
- Both restores: `git hash-object` equal to the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The aggregates read the fail-fast shape correctly.** Measured on run 30271824408 (the #3668 experiment, a fail-fast matrix): shard 1 concluded `failure`, shard 2 concluded `cancelled`, and the observer read the matrix result as `failure`. The cancelled shard's check run 89995981782 carries the annotation `The strategy configuration was canceled because "matrix._1" failed` (read from the check-run annotations endpoint). So `Test Core` and the Dogfood Regression Gate read `failure` (a declared negative, plus the missing credentials), and `Test UI` reads anything but `success` (or a filter-explained skip) as red.
- **A fail-fast queue run is never borrowed by a push (#31611, df91a35d).** `queueRunVerdict` in `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` covers a commit only when its queue run concluded `success`; a run whose aggregate is red concludes `failure`. `testUiFullGreen` counts only `Test UI (k/16)` jobs that concluded `success`, so a cancelled shard makes `ui_full_green` false and the push runs Test UI. Both are pinned by that script's existing self-test (a `failure` queue run, and 15 of 16 green shards). Nothing in that file changes.
- **What a red queue run shows now.** Only the shards that finished before the first red one, plus that one. The author's pull_request run of the same diff still shows every red shard (ruling 6139629628 A1, unchanged there).
- **Reading after landing (owed by the devx seat, on #31517):** for 7 days of `merge_group` runs of ci.yml, the queue time from the first red `Test Core (k/8)`, `Test UI (k/16)` or `Dogfood Regression Gate (k/3)` shard to the matching aggregate concluding red, compared with the same reading over the 7 days before landing.
- **Noted, not filed (pre-existing, unchanged here):** a matrix where every shard is killed by its own timeout before any shard attests reads `cancelled` with zero attestations, and that is #3668's pass with no cause read (ruled not extended on #22653). Fail-fast does not widen it: a timeout fires at 60 or 30 minutes, long after the fast shards attest, and a shard that goes red first makes the matrix read `failure`.
